about: Frame intervals (tenths of a millisecond) that this PC (RTX 3080, headless Edge, Famille, the processor 88 to 100 % busy with other sessions, the guard at its default) showed in the funfair mirror maze on 25 October 2026: the full mirror's frames, then the light mirror's frames that drew the reflection and those that kept it, in order (frames without a live mirror, paused ones and hitches over 0.5 s left out). 'by' says whose session: the verifiers' (fourth review, under the third round's guard; their frame logs stayed in their scratch folder) or the proof's own (validation/funfair-mirrors-2026-10-24/mirror-proof.mjs --gpu, under this guard; 'zombies': six zombies standing in the maze while the survivor fires). Replayed by test/fixtures/funfair-mirrors-check.mjs against MIRROR_BUDGET.
